Name: (CP) Apple Recipes
Author: suushiico
Description:
[size=2][center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.


Expands the recipe book with 10 brand new recipes for apples.[/center][/size]

[size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size]

You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I get the recipes?
[/b][/size]You can purchase every recipe from the Stardrop Saloon.

[size=4][b]What are the 10 new recipes?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Caramel Apple[/size]
[*][size=2]Spicy Apple Slaw[/size]
[*][size=2]Apple Banana Smoothie[/size]
[*][size=2]Honey-Dipped Apples[/size]
[*][size=2]Apple Chips[/size]
[*][size=2]Stuffed Apple Fruit Salad[/size]
[*][size=2]Pumpkin Apple Pie[/size]
[*][size=2]Even More Complete Breakfast[/size]
[*][size=2]Blueberry Apple Scone[/size]
[*][size=2]Apple Hazelnut Cider[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Is this mod balanced?[/b][/size]
[size=2]Kinda, sorta, not really :P
I wanted these dishes to be profitable in order to encourage modders to actually cook my recipes and use them in-game. As such, they're worth fairly high and offer a good portion of energy/health. The dishes are certainly not cheat-levels of profit, but definitely not as balanced as vanilla recipes.
